about: Skeleton-only animation clips (strip_rig_glb.gd 'anim' mode) rigged by Higgsfield 3d_rigging (Meshy) on the already-uploaded enemy meshes. Each clip carries that enemy's own 24-bone Meshy skeleton (same bone names as Sol's: Hips, Spine02, Spine01, Spine, neck, Head, LeftArm, ...), so all clips of one enemy share one skeleton. Positions inside the GLB are centimetres; times are seconds. strike_time = peak hand speed measured from the clip (assets_r3 clipinfo.gd). root_motion_m = hips travel over the whole clip (x, y, z; +z is the character's facing). The 6-12 MB full rig downloads (mesh + skin) stay out of git.

clips.notes: hunched, head-down aggressive sprint. Drop the hips z travel to loop in place (the clip covers about 7 m/s).
both arms rise overhead (0.9-1.3 s) and crash down; ends crouched. A clear telegraph for a parry window.
springs forward about 4.7 m and lands in a crouch at about 1.3 s (the hit), then recovers. Leap_and_Punch (464) was the first choice, but the rigger failed on it twice (refunded).
drops into a wide hunched stance with arms out and screams (0.9-2.0 s). For aggro, taunts or the Hollow Alpha's phase change; play the werewolf roar SFX at about 0.9 s.
knocked off its feet, lands flat on its back. Check the sign of the hips z travel when wiring (it slides 1.44 m in clip space).
deep step-in with the arm fully extended; reads as a clawed thrust with no weapon. Trim to about 1.6 s for gameplay; the rest is recovery.
four wide raking arm swings while advancing 1.5 m; no weapon pose. Can be cut into a 2-hit and a 4-hit string.
in-place standing backflip; add the backward displacement in code (2-3 m) and i-frames around 0.6-1.4 s.

hollow_alpha: The Hollow Alpha boss reuses the werewolf mesh and these werewolf clips at a larger scale (see ../bosses/hollow_alpha/manifest.json).
